text:
maya: Quick sync — we need final signoffs for the launch readiness checklist. Can owners confirm SLA, docs, oncall, monitoring, and pricing?
sam: On SLA — target is 99.9% availability, p95 < 120ms, p99 < 350ms for typical gen requests. Is everyone ok with fallback to v1 if latency breaches?
devin: p99 at 350ms is tight for some tails. We should plan a degraded-mode fallback to smaller model at 400ms, yes. Also request SLO burn rate alert at 10% over 1h.
maya: Good. @devin can you add the burn-rate alert to the runbook and set owner?
devin: Yep. I'll add in the monitoring doc and tag oncall-owner: sam.
alex: Pricing/finops check: need to lock the three tiers (starter/pro/enterprise). Starter should have strict rate limits and lower QPS, pro has burst tier, enterprise gets reserved capacity with SLA credits. Any objections?
liz: Docs: I'll draft the quickstart + troubleshooting for each tier. Need sample curl + SDK snippets and a short playbook for common latency/noise issues.
sam: Oncall coverage: primary + backup for first 2 weeks post-launch, then rotate to normal cadence. Need roster names day-of.
maya: Who signs the launch (ops, eng, product, finops, docs)? I can collect signatures but want a list.
alex: I can sign for finops once pricing table final.
liz: Docs signed once quickstart + rollback steps exist. ETA EOD tomorrow for drafts.
sam: Eng + SRE signoff pending smoke tests and chaos run. I'll run smoke tonight and run limited chaos tomorrow morning.
devin: Add a canary policy: 1% traffic first 3 hours, 10% after 24h if no regressions, then ramp. Include automatic rollback on error-rate > 2% or latency SLO violation.
maya: Add to rollout plan: contact list, escalation matrix, and customer comms template. Who owns customer comms?
alex: Customer comms — sales + account execs. I'll coordinate the wording and include a cost/overage FAQ.
liz: Will include a small "what to expect" doc for customers about cold starts and quantization artifacts.
sam: Observability items: token-level cost dashboards, per-route latency, sample payload traces, and model-version diffs. Need retention policy for traces (30 days).
devin: Also add synthetic prompt set for quality regression detection. Hook eval alerts to the infra channel.
maya: Ops-bot: remind me to collect signatures at launch T-24h.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled for 6571238000 (T-24h).
alex: One open risk: reserved-capacity sizing. We need org commitments for enterprise customers or we'll undersize. Who will own commit collection?
maya: Sales owns collection, product to set minimums. I'll follow up with @alex and sales.
sam: Final checklist for signoff: SLA doc, runbook, monitoring alerts, smoke test results, docs published, pricing table locked, oncall roster.
maya: I'll circulate a final checklist doc and a short form for the owners to sign. Aim to close by T-12h.
liz: I'll post the docs link once drafts are up.
devin: Running the smoke now, will report status in 30m.
sam: thanks — ping if you need extra infra capacity. :thumbsup:
